🚨 WE ARE HIRING | STRESS ENGINEER | AEROSPACE
📍 Job Location: Bangalore
💼 Role: Stress Engineer
🏢 Industry: Aerospace
📧 Apply: reena.kumari@saracasolutions.com
🔹 Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced Stress Engineer to perform structural and stress analysis of aircraft components and assemblies. The candidate will work closely with cross-functional engineering teams to support structural integrity, certification, and aerospace programs.
🔹 Key Responsibilities
• Perform stress and structural analysis of aircraft components and assemblies.
• Conduct static, fatigue, and damage tolerance analysis.
• Perform analysis using Finite Element Analysis (FEA) methods.
• Evaluate metallic and composite aerospace structures for structural integrity.
• Prepare detailed technical reports and documentation to support certification.
• Support engineering teams in resolving structural issues and providing technical solutions.
• Review engineering drawings, loads, materials, and manufacturing requirements.
• Work with cross-functional teams to deliver analysis activities within project timelines.
🔹 Required Skills
✅ Strong experience in Stress/Structural Analysis.
✅ Experience in the Aerospace/Aviation domain.
✅ Hands-on experience with MSC Patran/Nastran, HyperMesh or similar FEA tools.
✅ Knowledge of static, fatigue, buckling, and damage tolerance analysis.
✅ Strong understanding of Strength of Materials, engineering fundamentals, loads and material properties.
✅ Ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.
✅ Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
📩 How to Apply
Interested candidates can share their updated resume at:
reena.kumari@saracasolutions.com

🚨 WE’RE HIRING | MANUFACTURING ENGINEER - SHOULD COSTING 🚨
📍 Location: Bangalore
💼 Experience: 5+ Years
🏭 Industry: Aerospace / Automotive / Manufacturing
🔹 Position Summary
We are looking for an experienced Manufacturing Engineer to develop manufacturing process plans, should-cost models, and manufacturing documentation for Machining, Sheetmetal, Forging, and Casting processes. The role will support manufacturability, cost optimization, manufacturing readiness, NPI, and continuous improvement initiatives.
🔹 Key Responsibilities
• Develop manufacturing process plans and should-cost estimates using engineering drawings, specifications, and GD&T.
• Evaluate manufacturability, process selection, tooling, cycle times, and production methods.
• Prepare and maintain PFDs, PFMEAs, Manufacturing Routers, SOPs, and Work Instructions.
• Maintain manufacturing data in SAP and MES (Solumina or equivalent).
• Analyze supplier quotations and validate tooling/NRE costs.
• Develop cost models, work-center rates, labor standards, and cost databases.
• Support NPI, Value Engineering, DFM/DFC, and cost-reduction initiatives.
🔹 Basic Qualifications
• Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Mechanical, Production, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in Manufacturing Engineering and Should-Cost Analysis.
• Hands-on shop-floor experience in Aerospace, Automotive, or similar manufacturing industries.
🔹 Preferred Skills
• Strong knowledge of Machining, Sheetmetal, Forging, Casting, and Assembly processes.
• Experience in process planning, tooling, production optimization, and secondary processes.
• Proficiency in PFD, PFMEA, Routers, SOPs, and Work Instructions.
• Experience with SAP, MES/Solumina, and should-costing tools such as aPriori.
• Knowledge of Siemens NX, Creo, CATIA, or SolidWorks.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
📩 Interested candidates can share their updated resume at:
reena.kumari@saracasolutions.com
